title: Return-to-Store Bonus on Replacement Purchases
content:
# Return-to-Store Bonus on Replacement Purchases

Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda store loyalty terms. The replacement purchase is the holder's most recently signed group purchase deal in the Vehicle Purchase Agreements records: the deal whose vehicle price was charged last (of two charged the same day, the one recorded first), where that deal stands in contracted status. A bonus is added to the replacement vehicle credit where that purchase is made at the store that sold the waiver's own purchase deal, with a larger bonus where it carries a trade-in (a trade-in allowance above 0.00 on the replacement deal). The store and the trade-in allowance are read from the two deals' Vehicle Purchase Agreements records.

**Truth table**

| Same store as the waiver's purchase deal | Trade-in allowance above 0.00 | Bonus added |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 300.00 |
| Yes | No | 150.00 |
| No | Yes | None |
| No | No | None |

**Basis notes**

- The store test compares the selling store of the replacement deal with the selling store of the deal that carries the waiver; any other group store earns no return-store bonus.
- A trade-in allowance of exactly 0.00 counts as no trade-in.

**Hypothetical example.** A holder whose waiver was sold on a deal at one rooftop buys the replacement at the same rooftop with a trade-in allowed at 2,150.00: the bonus is 300.00. Bought there with no trade-in: 150.00.
